# Dev-only. NOTHING here may reach the running service.
#
# `requirements.txt` is generated by `uv export --no-dev` from the `[project]
# dependencies` in pyproject.toml, and it is what the container installs. These
# two packages are deliberately kept out of it: they belong to
# `tools/research_to_kb.py`, which converts research PDFs into knowledge-base
# rows offline and is never imported by anything under `app/`.
#
# `tests/test_no_pinecone_in_app.py` fails the build if that ever stops being
# true, so the boundary is enforced by CI rather than by memory.
#
#     pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
#
# They are not in pyproject's `[dependency-groups] dev` on purpose: adding them
# there without regenerating uv.lock would leave the two out of step, and
# regenerating the lock is a bigger change than a dev tool warrants days before
# a submission.

pinecone
pinecone-plugin-assistant
